items.content_html:
Représenter une sphère sur un plan est un problème de géométrie pure que l'humanité tente de résoudre depuis plus de 2 000 ans.Une carte plate peut montrer fidèlement une ou plusieurs propriétés du territoire, telles que la distance, la forme ou la direction, mais jamais d'un seul coup.Il y aura toujours une certaine forme de distorsion, et dans le cas de la récente résolution de l'ONU, le problème de Mercator – la projection utilisée dans les écoles, les manuels scolaires, les organisations internationales et même dans notre GPS – réside dans la taille des continents.

items.content_html: Five countries border the Caspian Sea, but none owns a fixed share. A 2018 convention established rules for navigation, security and fishing while leaving some seabed borders unresolved.

items.title: In drought-stricken France, tankers supply drinking water
items.content_html: France is seeing water shortages in regions that usually have plenty of supply. This summer's extreme heat is exposing how unprepared much of the country, and Europe, is for increasing water scarcity.

items.title: Will Germany's drought push up food prices?
items.content_html: Germany's main farmers' association has warned of a below-average harvest after drought and crops damaged by extreme heat. DW looks into what lower yields could mean for food prices and grocery bills.

items.title: How to grow food for more people in a hotter world
items.content_html: Inside futuristic labs, plants are scanned, stressed and analyzed. The aim is to use the results to produce plant strains that can better serve a growing population in a warming world.

items.title: Do not inhale! How wildfire smoke 'affects the whole body'
items.content_html: Wildfires destroy lives and livelihoods. But survivors and firefighters also suffer long-term harm to their health. A growing body of research suggests particulate matter (PM2.5) in wildfire smoke is a major culprit.

items.title: Norway wealth fund sounds alarm on AI stock market bubble
items.content_html: The head of Norway's sovereign wealth fund has warned that soaring AI-driven stock valuations could trigger a sharp correction. How exposed is the world's largest sovereign wealth fund to a market downturn?

items.title: Can the cool north handle a surge in climate tourism?
items.content_html: With heat records continually being broken and southern summers getting hotter, travelers are heading north. Fragile ecosystems are paying the price.

items.title: Fatty food raises risk of colorectal cancer
items.content_html: Did you know fatty foods can increase production of an acid in your gut that promotes tumor growth? That's on top of all the other health risks linked to fatty foods, like fries and burgers.
